# wso2is_saml_idp_configuration (Resource)

Manages the server's settings as a SAML identity provider, such as its metadata and destination URLs. The resource only changes the settings that you set. Other settings keep their current values. When you destroy this resource, the provider restores the server defaults. Each tenant (or organization) has one set of these settings. To import them, use the ID `saml_idp_configuration`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_saml_idp_configuration" "this" {
  metadata_validity_period = 120
  enable_metadata_signing  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `destination_urls` (List of String) SAML SSO endpoint URLs advertised to service providers.
- `enable_metadata_signing` (Boolean) Sign the published metadata.
- `metadata_validity_period` (Number) Validity of the published metadata, in minutes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `saml_idp_configuration`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_saml_idp_configuration.this saml_idp_configuration
```
